name: fix-validation-order
body: source: 'fail-fast: stops at the first error'; inconsistency: "first" was undefined, so the reported error was non-deterministic (feedback-1); resolution: fixed validation order — (1) eypres.yaml, (2) slide filenames (numbering, letters, label uniqueness), (3) each slide in number/letter order, top-to-bottom by line (frontmatter, body, sections, fields), (4) inter-slide #label links last since they need all labels known — written into the requirement, validate-deck service and deck-validator component [with user]
